note: The main banks: Maduro & Curiel's Bank (MCB), RBC Royal Bank and CIBC Caribbean, Curaçao's largest retail banks. RBC Royal Bank's Curaçao credit cards page (rendered 30 October 2026): its personal RBC Rewards Visa Platinum, Visa Gold and Visa Classic International, in US dollars, each with its annual fee and its 18% purchase and cash advance rates; its business cards aren't written, and the page states no other fee. Maduro & Curiel's Bank's credit cards, services and fees page (read 30 October 2026; all fees include turnover tax, the OB): its eleven personal cards, the Kompa Leon Classic, Efektivo, FunMiles and Aadvantage in Caribbean guilders and the Mastercard and Visa Gold, Visa and Mastercard Classic, Visa Aadvantage, Visa Platinum Aadvantage and Mastercard Black Consumer in US dollars, each at 18% a year, with its annual membership fee (none on the Efektivo), its late payment and over limit fees, and a cash advance fee of 3.18% at an ATM or a teller (at least 10.60). Its fraud protection fee is given without its period and isn't written, nor are the optional balance protection, the lost or stolen card fee and the company cards; the page states no minimum payment, foreign transaction fee or penalty rate. CIBC Caribbean's Curaçao schedule of charges isn't among those its site serves (30 October 2026), so its cards aren't written. This file kept RBC's Visa Classic International, read on 29 October 2026.
